rule: Reviewer fix-cycle commits are sanctioned, never forbidden
description: Commit/push authority is now a structural POSITIVE GRANT ALLOWLIST in safety-rails.md's Commit Authority subsection (COMMIT-GRANT marker lines for orchestrator, local-reviewer, github-reviewer, delegated-implementer). set_check asserts the grant SET itself (equal mode + expected_counts) so a deleted grant, an unreviewed extra grant, or a duplicated grant all fail structurally instead of requiring one more literal clause pin per review pass. The remaining consumers entries are a bounded tail: the source-of-truth sentence, one citation-anchor pin per referencing agent doc, and the small set of step-mechanics clauses that are not expressible as a grant-set member.

source.pattern: Commit and push authority is a POSITIVE GRANT

consumers.pattern: EXPLICITLY forbids this agent from committing
Absence of commit-policy language is not a prohibition
This checkpoint is load-bearing for convergence
MUST SANCTION the reviewer's own fix-cycle checkpoint commits
this prohibition is scoped to WAVE WORKER delegations
